purpose: Curated index of repository assets and operational evidence used to plan and evaluate future USG development.

phases.name: Canonical semantic contract and native interoperability
phases.open_work: Future contract migrations require explicit versioned migration and compatibility acceptance.

phases.name: Structured semantic reasoning
phases.open_work: Structured reasoning over explicit USG-SEM documents; not free-form natural-language interpretation.

phases.name: Canonical graph persistence and local workspace
phases.open_work: SQLite remains canonical; alternative storage backends are comparison/evaluation only.

phases.name: Bounded raw-text interpretation
phases.open_work: Tiny registered SVO/VSO and lexical/frame scope only; broader constructions require separate evidence.

phases.name: Bilingual staged interpretation pipeline
phases.open_work: 100-case acceptance covers three simple-transitive constructions; resource and construction expansion remains bounded.

phases.name: Expanded semantic interpretation
phases.open_work: Registered synthetic profiles accepted; construction expansion continues candidate-only; semantic assertion projection remains unaccepted.

phases.name: Semantic knowledge integration and contextual retrieval
phases.open_work: All ten steps merged; 102 frozen bilingual retrieval cases passed; 43 cross-language mappings remain unresolved.

phases.name: System-wide evidence, resource, and development intelligence
phases.open_work: Build a maintained resource/evidence catalogue and phase-aware routing mechanism before expanding semantic runtime scope.

source_families.title: Canonical semantic interchange
source_families.description: Normative USG-SEM/1.0 schema, semantic contract, Python adapters, and Workbench interoperability boundaries.
guardrails: Do not modify USG-SEM/1.0 incidentally.
A PARTIAL adapter mapping is not semantic failure when content is preserved.
Contract changes require a versioned migration and cross-adapter acceptance.

source_families.title: Seven development phases and acceptance records
source_families.description: Roadmaps, completion records, step implementations, and explicit non-claims for Phases 1–7.
guardrails: Retain each phase's acceptance boundary.
Do not infer phase completeness from file existence.
Phase 6 continuation is separate from its bounded exit.

source_families.title: Phase 2 structured reasoning
source_families.description: Grounding, rule registry/semantics, deterministic inference, evidence/conflict assessment, query/explanation, and associated benchmarks.
guardrails: Structured-document reasoning is not free-form language understanding.
Preserve evidence and conflict dimensions separately.
Do not infer objective truth from rule execution.

source_families.title: Canonical SQLite persistence and workspace
source_families.description: Phase 3 SQLite authority, local API/CLI, Kernel Lab, immutable revisions, replay, and alternative backend evaluations.
guardrails: SQLite is the canonical persistence authority.
DuckDB/LanceDB/Qdrant/RocksDB comparisons are not competing runtime stores.

source_families.title: Phase 4 and Phase 5 interpretation pipelines
source_families.description: Versioned source, lexical, segmentation, syntax, operator, composition, discourse, resource, API, CLI, and replay stages.
guardrails: Phase 4/5 construction metrics apply only to their registered populations.
Phase 5 envelopes are not USG-SEM/1.0 documents.
Unsupported and ambiguous results must remain visible.

source_families.title: Phase 6 broader semantic construction candidates
source_families.description: Predicate/argument structures, semantic frames, nominal candidates, morphology experiments, automatic acceptance, and continuation tracking.
guardrails: Phase 6 runtime results remain candidate-only.
Step 6.12 acceptance is OPAQUE preservation only.
Naturalistic semantic correctness is not established by synthetic acceptance.

source_families.title: Phase 7 semantic knowledge layer
source_families.description: Typed records, persistent snapshots, rights-aware source adapters, relation registry, contextual retrieval, read-only consumer integration, inspection APIs, and frozen evaluation.
guardrails: Unresolved mappings are not accepted translations or equivalences.
Consumer adapters are read-only.
Candidate evidence is never promoted by catalogue generation.

source_families.title: Versioned lexical candidate adapter
source_families.description: USG-LEXICAL-CANDIDATES/0.1.0 schema, source-preserving adapter, provider rights, identity checks, and candidate-only boundary.
guardrails: Rights default to UNKNOWN unless explicitly overridden.
The adapter does not activate runtime lexicon records.
Definitions/examples are withheld unless redistribution rights are explicitly cleared.

source_families.title: OOV and lexical ambiguity regression suite
source_families.description: English and Arabic OOV behavior, homograph/sense alternatives, candidate set preservation, and no unsupported unique interpretation.
guardrails: No unique POS/sense when evidence is ambiguous.
OOV is not converted into a guessed known word.
Keep candidate coverage distinct from contextual prediction precision.

source_families.title: Open-World randomized evaluation foundation
source_families.description: Repository capability inventory, target adapters, scenario generation, execution, operation oracles, accounting, blocker attribution, scoring, adaptive discovery, campaigns, coverage ledgers, and naturalistic pilot.
guardrails: Execution outcomes, structural validity, and semantic correctness are separate.
Randomized, controlled-diagnostic, and naturalistic populations remain separate.
A complete campaign is not an accuracy score.
Unexecuted targets and unregistered components remain explicit.

source_families.title: Evidence-driven growth planner
source_families.description: Growth policy, blocker attribution, ranked investigations, backlog links, and scheduled 90-day growth-plan artifacts.
guardrails: First blocker is a diagnostic starting point, not proven causation.
Planner ranking is not an intelligence or correctness score.
Planner performs no runtime mutation or semantic promotion.

source_families.title: External lexical knowledge acquisition
source_families.description: Incremental pinned-source crawl, checkpoint/manifest/shards, retry recovery, structural audit, candidate analysis, and independent PUD lexical/morphology evaluation.
guardrails: Crawler output is candidate evidence only.
Do not store or redistribute raw definitions/examples absent rights.
External PUD metrics describe exact candidate coverage, not contextual POS or semantic accuracy.

source_families.title: Naturalistic PUD evaluation population
source_families.description: Pinned English/Arabic PUD source, privacy/source checks, deterministic sampling, and explicitly input-only naturalistic evaluation.
guardrails: No semantic gold is inferred from UD POS/dependencies.
Arabic PUD is translated and is not representative of native MSA/conversational input.
Keep naturalistic population separate from randomized and synthetic diagnostics.

source_families.title: Cross-implementation conformance
source_families.description: Inventory and common-contract gates across JavaScript Workbench, Python kernels, interpreters, adapters, and APIs.
guardrails: Component tests do not imply cross-runtime equivalence.
Cross-runtime agreement does not establish semantic correctness.
Compare normalized outputs and retain disagreement cases.

source_families.title: Bundled lexical, construction, frame, and operator resources
source_families.description: Versioned English/MSA Arabic lexical foundations, candidate lexicons, nominal/predicate construction rules, semantic frames, and operator inventories.
guardrails: Track resource versions and digests per interpretation.
Candidate resources must not silently replace accepted runtime profiles.
Language-specific morphology and lexicalization remain distinct from concept alignment.

source_families.title: System-wide assessment and improvement backlog
source_families.description: Historical capability assessment, prioritized system improvement queue, evidence-driven status, and bounded autonomy policy.
guardrails: Historical assessments must be marked as dated baselines.
A missing measurement is not zero.
Changes to accepted phases require traceable amendments and regression protection.

source_families.title: Python native model generations and adapters
source_families.description: Versioned Python native model packages, record-family implementations, document adapters, and composed interoperability adapters.
guardrails: Different native model versions are separate implementation lines until conformance tests establish agreement.
An import test does not establish semantic correctness.

source_families.title: JavaScript Semantic Workbench
source_families.description: Versioned browser Workbench releases, browser execution adapter, canonical interchange bridge, and JavaScript regression suites.
guardrails: The tested browser path is English-only for the registered version; do not infer Arabic coverage.
Browser execution and canonical serialization do not establish semantic correctness.

source_families.title: Morphology, POS, and external treebank experiments
source_families.description: Pinned PUD morphology experiments, cross-validation, Stanza/spaCy/UD adapters, POS diagnostics, and language-specific morphology resources.
guardrails: Treebank UPOS/FEATS are not USG semantic-role gold.
Fold-trained morphology rules remain experimental candidate generators; they are not active runtime morphology.

source_families.title: Kernel Lab and local application interfaces
source_families.description: Loopback-only Kernel Lab, Phase 2/3 local API/CLI, Phase 4/5/6 interpretation endpoints, and Phase 7 knowledge inspection panel.
guardrails: Kernel Lab binds to loopback only.
Phase-specific APIs return different contracts; do not collapse envelopes into canonical documents.

source_families.title: GitHub Actions and scheduled system automation
source_families.description: CI validation, six-hour lexical crawl, daily growth planner, Open-World campaigns, naturalistic pilots, phase continuation trackers, and reporting workflows.
guardrails: Workflow configuration is not evidence that a run succeeded.
Scheduled work may be skipped or blocked by permissions; always collect actual run and artifact status.

source_families.title: Regression, contract, and phase acceptance test suites
source_families.description: Versioned unit, contract, integration, adapter, browser, benchmark, package-install, replay, and phase exit tests.
guardrails: A test only validates its declared assertion and corpus.
Skipped, not-executed, or infrastructure-failed tests are not passes.

source_families.title: System evidence catalogue, source registry, and phase resource manifests
source_families.description: Versioned source-family registry, phase consumer map, evidence collector, GitHub Actions status collector, snapshots, and mandatory phase resource manifests.
guardrails: Catalogue output is not semantic truth or runtime knowledge.
Resource consumer maps are declared intentions; verify actual imports and tests.
Phase manifests are required for Phase 8+ roadmaps.
Snapshots are append-only; no automatic phase or contract mutation.
